about.description:
pptxgenjs-plus is a maintained fork of PptxGenJS that creates PowerPoint
(.pptx) files from JavaScript/TypeScript. This conda package installs the
prebuilt npm library into the environment's global node_modules (no CLI).
Use ``NODE_PATH=$CONDA_PREFIX/lib/node_modules`` or a project that resolves
globally installed modules. Upstream ``engines.node`` is ``>=24``. The
sibling workspace package ``pptxgenjs-plus-jsx`` is not included.
about.summary: Build PowerPoint presentations with JavaScript (Node, browser, TypeScript)

script: NODE_PATH="${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules" node -e "const m = require('pptxgenjs-plus'); const P = m.default || m; const p = new P(); if (!p.addSlide) throw new Error('no addSlide'); console.log('pptxgenjs-plus OK', P.version || m.version || '')"

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "4.3.4"

package:
  name: pptxgenjs-plus
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://registry.npmjs.org/pptxgenjs-plus/-/pptxgenjs-plus-${{ version }}.tgz
  sha256: 91dad0729f2fb3f9e4df490fe02ce2bc23cd3e3554e5f04cfbcbca317be30144

build:
  number: 1
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - set -ex
        - pnpm install --ignore-scripts
        - npm pack --ignore-scripts
        - npm install --global ./pptxgenjs-plus-${{ version }}.tgz
        - pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --output-file=third-party-licenses.txt
        - rm -rf "${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules/pptxgenjs-plus/node_modules/.bin"
      else:
        - call pnpm install --ignore-scripts
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call npm pack --ignore-scripts
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call npm install --global "%SRC_DIR%\pptxgenjs-plus-${{ version }}.tgz"
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --output-file=third-party-licenses.txt
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - if exist "%PREFIX%\lib\node_modules\pptxgenjs-plus\node_modules\.bin" rmdir /s /q "%PREFIX%\lib\node_modules\pptxgenjs-plus\node_modules\.bin"
        - if exist "%PREFIX%\node_modules\pptxgenjs-plus\node_modules\.bin" rmdir /s /q "%PREFIX%\node_modules\pptxgenjs-plus\node_modules\.bin"

requirements:
  build:
    - nodejs >=24
    - pnpm
    - pnpm-licenses
  host:
    - nodejs >=24
  run:
    - nodejs >=24

tests:
  - script:
      - if: not win
        then:
          - test -f "${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules/pptxgenjs-plus/package.json"
          - NODE_PATH="${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules" node -e "const m = require('pptxgenjs-plus'); const P = m.default || m; const p = new P(); if (!p.addSlide) throw new Error('no addSlide'); console.log('pptxgenjs-plus OK', P.version || m.version || '')"
        else:
          - for /f "delims=" %%i in ('npm root -g') do set "NPM_GLOBAL_ROOT=%%i"
          - if not defined NPM_GLOBAL_ROOT exit 1
          - if not exist "%NPM_GLOBAL_ROOT%\pptxgenjs-plus\package.json" exit 1
          - set "NODE_PATH=%NPM_GLOBAL_ROOT%"
          - node -e "const m = require('pptxgenjs-plus'); const P = m.default || m; const p = new P(); if (!p.addSlide) throw new Error('no addSlide'); console.log('pptxgenjs-plus OK', P.version || m.version || '')"
          - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1

about:
  summary: Build PowerPoint presentations with JavaScript (Node, browser, TypeScript)
  description: |
    pptxgenjs-plus is a maintained fork of PptxGenJS that creates PowerPoint
    (.pptx) files from JavaScript/TypeScript. This conda package installs the
    prebuilt npm library into the environment's global node_modules (no CLI).
    Use ``NODE_PATH=$CONDA_PREFIX/lib/node_modules`` or a project that resolves
    globally installed modules. Upstream ``engines.node`` is ``>=24``. The
    sibling workspace package ``pptxgenjs-plus-jsx`` is not included.
  homepage: https://github.com/lofcz/pptxgenjs-plus
  repository: https://github.com/lofcz/pptxgenjs-plus
  documentation: https://lofcz.github.io/pptxgenjs-plus/
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - third-party-licenses.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
